resources.string: Your reliable companion to never forget a birthday again. All your contacts in one place, sorted by their big day.
To show you birthdays, BirthdayBuddy needs access to your system contacts. Your data stays locally on your device.
When should we remind you? You can also decide if reminders should stay active until you mark them as done.
Everything is configured. We are syncing your contacts now. Have fun with BirthdayBuddy!
